defects.title: Taxa whose name contains 'pan' are counted as unmapped
defects.trigger: raw.csv Taxon={'Bacteroides fragilis';'Ruminococcus champanellensis';'Lactobacillus panis';'Unknown species';''}, S1=[60;20;10;10;5], S2=[0;30;20;50;5], S3=1; mars.csv Taxon={'panBacteroides fragilis';'panRuminococcus chamellensis';'panLactobacillus panis'}, S1=[1;2;3]; meta.csv ID={'S1';'S2'}; microbiomeMappingStats('raw.csv','mars.csv',outDir,'meta.csv')
defects.observed: erase(MARS.Taxon,'pan') turns 'panLactobacillus panis' into 'Lactobacillus is'; alphaDiversities.csv 'alpha mapped' = 2 (S1), 1 (S2); sheet Mapped lists only Ruminococcus chamellensis and Bacteroides fragilis
defects.expected: only the 'pan' prefix removed: alpha mapped 3 (S1), 2 (S2); Lactobacillus panis in sheet Mapped

defects.title: The sheet of unmapped taxa is named 'Umapped'

notes: Repro (MATLAB, in a temp folder): writetable(table({'Bacteroides fragilis';'Ruminococcus champanellensis';'Lactobacillus panis';'Unknown species';''},[60;20;10;10;5],[0;30;20;50;5],[1;1;1;1;1],'VariableNames',{'Taxon','S1','S2','S3'}),'raw.csv'); writetable(table({'panBacteroides fragilis';'panRuminococcus chamellensis';'panLactobacillus panis'},[1;2;3],'VariableNames',{'Taxon','S1'}),'mars.csv'); writetable(table({'S1';'S2'},[30;40],'VariableNames',{'ID','age'}),'meta.csv'); mkdir out; microbiomeMappingStats('raw.csv','mars.csv','out','meta.csv'); readtable('out/alphaDiversities.csv','VariableNamingRule','preserve') -> alpha mapped [2;1]. (A single-column mars.csv is read with space delimiter and fails with 'Unrecognized table variable name Taxon'; real MARS tables have more columns.) Other findings not recorded as defects because not observable: mapping_stats (index table describing FBA tables, labels of rows 4/5 of the coverage stats swapped at lines 189-190) is built but never saved or returned; specAbunPath (184) unused; getRelAbundanceStats lines 271-272 and getTaxonLevelReadCounts (302-318) are dead code. No callers listed.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: erase(MARS.Taxon,'pan') removes the text anywhere in a name, line 118)

defects.title: The parallel mode cannot start its worker processes on Linux and macOS
defects.trigger: on Linux, ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral(sampleStruct, 1, 10, 60, 2) (proc = 2; gpSampler with threads = 2)
defects.observed: line 126 builds 'matlab ... -r ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral([],1,10,0,-1,'<pwd>');exit; &' with the -r argument unquoted; sh -c on it prints 'sh: 1: Syntax error: "(" unexpected'; MATLAB system() on the same text (matlab replaced by echo) returns status 2; no worker starts and the master waits at lines 286-296 for files only workers write (read from code)

defects.title: A log file is written into the current folder
defects.trigger: serial call from an empty folder (hand-built 2-D sampleStruct)
defects.observed: ACHRParallelError.txt created and left in the current folder

notes: Repro: in MATLAB, command = strcat('matlab -singleCompThread -automation -nojvm -r ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral([],',num2str(1),',',num2str(10),',0,', num2str(-1) ,',''' ,pwd, ''');exit; &'); [st,out] = system(strrep(command,'matlab ','echo ')) -> st = 2; in a shell: sh -c "echo ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral([],1,10,0,-1,'/tmp/x');exit; &" -> Syntax error. The master itself was not run (the permission classifier refused a probe that calls system('matlab ...')). Serial mode works (probe: 10 steps from a 2-D box). Lead decision: the defect is confined to the call form proc > 1 on non-Windows systems; gpSampler reaches it only with threads > 1 (default threads = 1 gives proc = 1, serial). If the lead prefers, serial and worker (proc < 0, file-driven) modes are testable with exemptions for the master-parallel lines.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: the worker command passes -r ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral(...);exit unquoted to the shell, lines 125-128; bash rejects the parentheses)
